description: Watch a video (local path or URL) as VLM-readable frame grids with timestamps and subtitles, or transcribe its audio with `transcribe: true`. Call with just `source` first: short videos run immediately, everything else answers with metadata and copyable next calls.

confirm.description: Echo a consent token issued by a previous response to authorize the pending action. Tokens stay valid until a newer plan for the same source replaces them; pass confirm alone with source.

from.description: Window start: seconds (83) or timestamp ("1:23", "1:02:03"). Omit to start from the beginning.

look.description: How to look: overview (fast triage), detailed (miss nothing), read_text (few large frames to read on-screen text/UI), track_motion (dense small frames for fast action). Subtitle text always rides along in metadata regardless; this only affects frame size/density. Omit for a balanced default.

raw.description: Expert escape hatch: verbatim agent-video core CLI arguments starting with the subcommand, e.g. "process --strategy keyframes --base-fps 0.2". Mutually exclusive with from/until/look/strategy. Input/output plumbing is injected by the server.

source.description: Local video file path or URL. Call with only `source` first; the response tells you what to do next.

strategy.description: Which moments become frames: adaptive (default: keyframes plus fill in sparse stretches, right for most footage), keyframes (cheapest scan, frames land on cuts — triage for edited footage, blind to changes inside static shots), uniform (evenly spaced in time — use when keyframes mislead: screen recordings, slides, long static takes). Orthogonal to look, which sets frame size/density.

transcribe.description: Set true (alone with source) to generate a whisper transcript of the audio; it is cached and rides along with every grid afterwards. Needs local media: for a URL, download it first (bare call, then confirm), then repeat with transcribe.

until.description: Window end, same formats. Omit to go to the end of the video.
